title: feat: support per-user RPM for catalog models
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reuses one `perUserRpm` model field for catalog and community models.
- Enforces limits across every modality and fallback attempt.
- Exposes configured limits through model-list endpoints.
- Leaves models uncapped when the field is unset.
- Adds focused limiter and fallback coverage.

gist.headline: A fairer queue at the flowerbed
gist.blurb: Catalog models can now carry their own per-user request pace, and the limit follows requests through every route and fallback. The garden stays orderly without putting fences around models that do not need them.
gist.summary: Added a shared perUserRpm field for catalog and community models, enforcing configured per-user limits across text, image, audio, realtime, 3D, proxy, and fallback requests while exposing those limits in model-list endpoints.
gist.impact: Developers can inspect each model's configured per-user RPM before using it, while uncapped models remain unrestricted and fallback attempts follow the same fair-use limit.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy shared API garden with several labeled model flowerpots feeding into one gentle traffic gate; Polli acts as a thoughtful garden keeper, checking a small RPM sign while request bees take orderly paths through text, image, audio, and fallback vines. The scene should show that some pots have a limit marker while others remain open, with a retro terminal displaying a model list.
